tool.name: SpatialStatistics
tool.summary: Windowed statistics: the variance, standard deviation, skewness, kurtosis, minimum, maximum, mean or median of the values in a circular window around each cell.
tool.usage:
The window is a circle whose diameter is the window size; no-data cells are left out, and a window needs at least 3 valid values.

Skewness and kurtosis are the biased estimates of scipy.stats (kurtosis is the excess kurtosis, 0 for a normal distribution); a near-constant window gives no-data.

param.name: in_raster
param.dialogReference: Grid to process (a single-band raster; no-data cells are left as no-data in the result).
param.pythonReference: Grid to process (a single-band raster; no-data cells are left as no-data in the result).

param.name: out_raster
param.dialogReference: Output raster (GeoTIFF), with the input's extent, cell size and coordinate system.
param.pythonReference: Output raster (GeoTIFF), with the input's extent, cell size and coordinate system.

param.name: window_size
param.dialogReference: Diameter of the circular window in pixels (odd; an even value is rounded up).
param.pythonReference: Diameter of the circular window in pixels (odd; an even value is rounded up).
